subject.title: fix: reasoning-only and empty-response retries duplicate the user message in the session

question: Should reasoning-only and empty-response retry limits become supported process-wide environment controls in this PR?
rationale: Those controls are not needed to fix transcript duplication and create new configuration surface under OpenClaw's high bar for environment additions.

options.title: Split the controls
options.body: Land the proven persistence repair now and consider retry tunability in a separate product-reviewed change.

options.title: Approve and document
options.body: Keep both variables as supported controls with public documentation of defaults, zero behavior, invalid-value fallback, and process-start timing.

recommendation.title: Split the controls
recommendation.body: Land the proven persistence repair now and consider retry tunability in a separate product-reviewed change.

likelyOwner.reason: They approved and merged the existing retry-persistence contract and are the strongest available history signal for deciding a related operator-policy expansion.
